description: Searches tours, experiences and attractions from Viator in a city from a start date, with an optional end date and category (for example food tours, walking tours, museums or day trips). Results include name, category, duration, per-person price, rating and a photo; the response says whether these results can be booked. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone. If activities could not be checked, the result is { available: false, reason: "activities_unavailable", message } with no list: that does not mean "no activities" — pass on its message; flights, hotels and trips can still be searched and booked, and activities can be added after opening a booking link.

date_to.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to date_from for single-day searches.

place.description: The exact place of this trip stop: the `place` an earlier search for the trip returned, or the candidate the person picked when a search asked which place they meant. Searches given the same place cover the same place.

airports.description: IATA codes of the airports serving the place.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (territories use their own, e.g. PR).

label.description: How to name the place to the person, e.g. 'Birmingham, GB'.

name: search_activities
